rows.text: The Official Cash Rate (OCR) will remain unchanged at 7.25 percent.
The Official Cash Rate (OCR) will remain unchanged at 7.25 percent.
Since our September Monetary Policy Statement, there has been a significant improvement to the near-term inflation outlook, mainly as a result of the recent decline in oil prices.

Indicators of medium-term inflation pressures remain significant.

Overall GDP growth in the second quarter was consistent with our September projections and the continued rebalancing of demand away from domestic spending towards exports.
